bio: Hi, I'm Abderrahmane Lartab, a Full Stack & AI Developer from Casablanca, Morocco. Currently in the AI Developer Program at YouCode, I build intelligent software combining React, Next.js, TypeScript, Laravel, and FastAPI with Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Azure Cloud.
about_paragraph_1: I'm Abderrahmane Lartab, a Full Stack & AI Developer from Casablanca, Morocco. Currently advancing my training in the AI Developer Program at YouCode (2026–2027) after completing Full Stack Web Development at OFPPT – ISAG Lalla Aicha (2024–2026) and interning at BRT Solutions on a School Management SaaS platform, I build modern web applications with React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Laravel, Node.js, and FastAPI.
about_paragraph_2: On the AI and data side, I work with Python, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, and YOLOv8 for machine learning, deep learning, and computer vision — alongside Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Azure Machine Learning, PySpark, Apache Airflow, MLflow, and Docker. My long-term goal is to build intelligent software products that seamlessly unite modern web engineering, AI models, LLMs, and cloud infrastructure.

mihna_description_1: Before Mihna, job seekers and employers often faced fragmented recruitment processes — candidates struggled to find relevant opportunities, while recruiters had difficulty managing and tracking applications effectively. Communication gaps and a lack of intelligent tools made hiring slow and inefficient.
mihna_description_2: Mihna is a full-stack web platform that bridges this gap by connecting candidates and employers through an intelligent, streamlined system. It offers automated application tracking, real-time notifications, and an integrated chatbot assistant — helping both sides save time, stay organized, and make smarter career decisions.
mihna_challenge: How can we create a seamless job-matching experience while keeping the platform simple and efficient for both candidates and companies? We aimed not just to replicate existing job portals, but to go beyond — offering smart recommendations, streamlined applications, and real-time interaction between talent and employers.
